item.title: How I Estimate Work as a Staff Software Engineer
item.description:
📝 As every experienced software engineer knows, it is not possible to accurately estimate software projects. I’m also going to concede that sometimes you can accurately estimate software work, when that work is very well-understood and very small in scope. It’s therefore impossible to accurately estimate software projects in advance.
🔗 Read more: https://www.seangoedecke.com/how-i-estimate-work/

item.title: Many Small Queries Are Efficient in SQLite
item.description:
📝 SQLite can also do large and complex queries efficiently, just like client/server databases. But SQLite can do many smaller queries efficiently too. Tickets need another set of queries.
🔗 Read more: https://www.sqlite.org/np1queryprob.html

item.title: MS confirms it will give the FBI your Windows PC data encryption key if asked
item.description:
📝 Windows PCs by default will backup their encryption keys to the cloud, and Microsoft isn't afraid to share those with the FBI if requested. Your Windows PC has likely backed up your encryption key without you realizing. (Image credit: Microsoft)It's frankly shocking that the encryption keys that do get uploaded to Microsoft aren't encrypted on the cloud side, too.
🔗 Read more: https://www.windowscentral.com/microsoft/windows-11/microsoft-bitlocker-encryption-keys-give-fbi-legal-order-privacy-nightmare

item.title: JVIC: New web-based Commodore VIC 20 emulator
Ask HN: May an Agent accepts a license to produce a build?
item.description:
📝 For example, Android builds steer towards using `sdkmanager --licenses`. That is the flow that exists many times in its training data (which represents its own interesting wrinkle). What is the legal status of an agreement accepted in such a manner - and perhaps more importantly - what ought to be the legal status considering that any position you take will be exploited by bad faith ~~actors~~ agents.
🔗 Read more: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46743867
